newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers steady, while Europe firms.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers steady, while Europe firms.

text.p: The Rotterdam bunker market resisted the gains of the barge market, while bunkers in the rest of Europe firmed, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers were still talked in the range $87/$88 fob, although barges rose to as high as $87. A couple of large enquiries emerged.
Majors picked up most of the business, squeezing out the independents which were unable to compete with the narrow differential between ex-wharf and delivered prices.
"I don't know who can do the barging for 50 cents," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices rose to around $94 fob, thus widening the premium over Rotterdam. The market was quiet.
Mediterranean fuel oil bunkers rose by around $3 a tonne as benchmark prices firmed. The strength encouraged some short covering.
Fujairah fuel oil quotes dipped by about $1 late in the day. Post-Easter covering meant trading was reasonably busy.
